title: Customer-Facing SLO Contracting and Initiative Mapping Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook for translating internal SLI targets and error-budget policies into customer-facing SLO contract language, and map those contracts to initiatives and remediation playbooks. The output should include standardized contract templates, an initiative-mapping matrix, escalation buckets tied to error budget burn rates, and a small automation shim to populate dashboards and PR templates.
background: Sales and Customer Success have repeatedly requested clearer, deterministic SLO language for contracts and handoffs to enterprise customers. Engineering teams have ad-hoc error-budget responses; product lacks a single source-of-truth that ties a customer-level SLO contract to the internal initiative that owns the remediation. This work sits at the intersection of Compliance, Sales, and Reliability teams and is intended to reduce negotiation friction and speed incident-to-initiative handoffs.
success_metrics: Reduce average contract negotiation time for SLO questions from 6 weeks to 2 weeks
>90% of enterprise contracts use the approved SLO template by EOD release
Cut mean time to attach an error-budget remediation initiative to an incident from 48h to 8h
Automated population of contract SLOs into the reliability dashboard for 100% of tracked customers
acceptance_criteria: Approved customer-facing SLO template (legal-reviewed) stored in Confluence
Initiative mapping matrix completed and validated by Eng, PM, Sales for top 20 customers
Dashboards and BigQuery views auto-populate contract SLOs and current error-budget consumption
Runbook steps for each escalation bucket with PagerDuty escalation policy links
2 pilot contracts executed using the new template and playbook with post-pilot retrospective

2025-03-05: Engineering feasibility sync — identified required telemetry: per-customer token and latency SLIs, error budget burn query. ENG-1842 flagged as dependency for telemetry changes.
2025-03-06: PM review with Sales; Sales asked for explicit RTO/RPO language for Dedicated customers. Added follow-up task to map Dedicated contract clauses.
